scope: Proposition 23.2 (Compact minimizing space and right area derivative) of the manuscript “Spacetime Penrose inequalities: enclosing area, charge, and rigidity” (preprints/Spacetime-Penrose-inequalities-enclosing-area-charge-and-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 794bf524061c4b36), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 125-126. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: The space T is compact and metrizable. If h is a smooth symmetric two-tensor, the function (23.8) a′ T (h) = 1 2 Z T trTxT h dAg is continuous on T . 126 OPENAI More generally, let gs, |s| < s0, be a smooth path of smooth metrics on X, with g0 = g, uniformly comparable to g, and with uniformly bounded first and second parameter derivatives relative to g. Assume that their large coordinate spheres have strictly positive outward mean curvature beyond one common radius. Write a(s) for their smooth-cut infimum and h = ∂sgs|s=0. Then (23.9) a′ (0+) = min T∈T a′ T (h). In particular the minimum on the right is attained. If sj → 0 and Tj is any minimizing frontier for gsj , a subsequence of its filled sets converges to a member of T , and its g-tangent-plane area measures converge to the corresponding measure.
